name: 3DGS-Avatar
definition: A method that reconstructs full-body avatars by combining Gaussians with both non-rigid and rigid transformations of an underlying SMPL model.
summary: 3DGS-Avatar reconstructs photorealistic, animatable human avatars by combining 3D Gaussian primitives with an SMPL model, using a shallow MLP for color and geometry priors to preserve fine cloth details.
